snippet.title: Ocean Pop! : Calypso Collision Game Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Announcing the newest game from circyn software: Ocean Pop! : Calypso Collision.  Merge cute underwater creatures together in this physics-based puzzle game. Can you complete the sequence to get to the Whale Shark? Can you merge two Whale Sharks? Travel to the ocean floor for a relaxing game with an upbeat calypso soundtrack and test your skills! 

Available to Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4144000/Ocean_Pop__Calypso_Collision/

Music licensed by ROK under Standard Unity Asset Store EULA.

ROK website: https://rokonmusic.wordpress.com/
ROK Unity store listing: https://assetstore.unity.com/publishers/103371
